newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders lower.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle calls mixed, feeders lower.

text.p: Early calls on CME live cattle futures ranged from 0.100 cent lower to 0.100 higher on Wednesday while feeder cattle were called 0.100 to 0.200 cent lower, livestock analysts said.

Further rolling of long April positions into deferreds and currently weak boxed beef prices could weigh on the nearby. However, losses will be limited by expectations of increased beef demand ahead and tight packer slaughter supplies. Packers will need cattle for next weeks kill, analysts said.
Deferreds may again show support from the Taiwan situation and possible strong beef markets this summer, they said.
Action in pork pits ahead of the quarterly Hogs and Pigs report may also bring uneven trade, they said.

Feeder cattle futures were expected to show early pressure on expectations of higher corn futures after they export sales report. This will likely offset a higher CME feeder cattle index. Action in other pits ahead of the hog report may also influenced trade, they added.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was up $0.12 at $69.47 per cwt.
